title: VF-010's benchmark at the fix (run 1 of 2): the own checker's runs with conflict-budgeted probes, recorded for comparison with the fix's parent
description: VF-010 (verification/findings.md): the fix budgets the own checker's branch probes in solver conflicts instead of wall-clock time (Engine::probe, lib/src/bmc/mod.rs). To check that no recorded own-checker verdict changes with it, the benchmark's own-checker runs are recorded at the fix (this job, --revision f606b0d8, the fix) and at the fix's parent (run 2 of 2, --revision c307e721), and a later quick job compares the two outputs, as the examples stream does for VF-014. Not compared with lib/benchmark/results.json, which VF-014 shows is stale. This job only records: it passes when the benchmark runs. Resubmitted for VF-021: the first pair (20261107-165544-...-run-1-of-2 and ...-s-parent-r) was stopped by SIGTERM because both ids share their first 40 characters, which the runner uses for a step's systemd scope (vjob-<id[:40]>-<step>), so each job's step stopped the other's as a leftover of the same name. These two ids differ within the first 40 characters. VF-021 closes when both pass and the comparison shows no verdict changed.

resources.notes: the first run of this job reached 2m19s and 1.5 GiB before it was stopped; job 20261107-041414's step 1, the same command, took 168 s with a 1.1 GiB peak

steps.name: benchmark, own checker only
steps.run: (cd lib && cargo build --release -q) && python3 lib/benchmark/run.py --engines native --out lib/target/benchmark-native-vf010-fix.json --table lib/target/benchmark-native-vf010-fix.md
